name: Ablative Armor Maintenance

civilopediaText.text: Found the manual in the back of the cargo bay. Turns out you're not supposed to scrape it off with a rusty putty knife. Who knew?
A quick script patch pushed to the turret subroutines, and suddenly incoming ordnance doesn't bypass the interceptors quite so casually.
Why stop at tweaking point defense when you can write a custom regex parser to swat autonomous drones out of the vacuum like digital mosquitoes?
Achieving peak combat efficiency only when cosmic static hurts everyone's artificial joints and meteorological sensors.
Optimal relativistic coordination. Only matters from the right perspective; from the enemy's perspective, you hit them five minutes ago.
Thought they'd know how to work together before launching in a $42 trillion flagship? Wrong! They are currently holding an emergency seminar on synergy while under heavy fire.

name: Synergy Achieved

civilopediaText.text: After surviving three near-death experiences, a hull breach, and a bitter mutiny over breakroom coffee blend preferences, the crew finally achieved peak corporate synergy.
